description: Header file defining a doubly linked list (dlist) data structure, macros, inline functions, and API for list operations.

methods.name: ds_dlist_is_empty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.

methods.name: ds_dlist_next
methods.description: Returns the next element in the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_prev
methods.description: Returns the previous element in the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_head
methods.description: Returns the head element of the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_tail
methods.description: Returns the tail element of the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_insert_head
methods.description: Inserts an element at the head of the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_insert_tail
methods.description: Inserts an element at the tail of the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_insert_after
methods.description: Inserts an element after a specified element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_insert_before
methods.description: Inserts an element before a specified element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_remove
methods.description: Removes a specified element from the list.

methods.name: ds_dlist_remove_head
methods.description: Removes and returns the head element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_remove_tail
methods.description: Removes and returns the tail element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_remove_after
methods.description: Removes the element after a specified element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_remove_before
methods.description: Removes the element before a specified element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_ifirst
methods.description: Initializes iteration at the first element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_inext
methods.description: Advances iteration to the next element.

methods.name: ds_dlist_iremove
methods.description: Removes the current element during iteration.
